description: The full build prompt for one template. Needs the user's Vibesignet access key, sent as the Authorization header of this connection or as the access_key argument. A free key unlocks 1 template of the user's choice; fetching it again is free.

access_key.description: The user's access key (starts with vs_), if it was not set on the connection.
